rho.note: The matched rho records emit no unpriced counter (no canonicalisation, distinguished-point test, Frobenius map or table operation counts); only steps (walk group additions) and S. U_rho = 0 in the strict band, so rho is a lower bound at w > 0; rho_ext_* charge k native ops per walk step as a sensitivity.
